description: 12-channel Firefly optical transceiver with per-channel monitoring and control. Tx and Rx are separate physical TWI devices with independent register spaces at the addresses below (see cm_interface.device.firefly.FireflyTx / FireflyRx) -- this file documents both since they share the same manufacturer datasheet and byte layout. CERN-B variants use a different map: see firefly_cernb.json.
uart_address_range: device_number = uart_address - 0x20 (a synthetic MCU ProgCom index, NOT the physical I2C/TWI address -- see X12 Table 9 for the real TWI addresses, e.g. 0x50/0x54)

VCC_MONITOR.description: Supply voltage, 16-bit unsigned (100 µV LSB), range 0-6.55V, accuracy ±3%

ELAPSED_TIME.description: Operating time, 16-bit unsigned (2 hours LSB), range 0-131,070 hours

RESET.description: Writing 0x01 defaults all registers. Datasheet marks this RW, not write-only.

STATUS_SUMMARY.description: Table 12. Bit 0 is cleared by reading this byte.

TX_FAULT_LATCH.description: Latched TX fault flags (12 channels, bits 0-11). Latched bits clear on read or module reset (may re-assert immediately if the fault persists and its mask bit is unset).

TX_DISABLE.description: Per-channel TX disable (bits 0-11 for CH0-CH11, 0-based datasheet numbering; the Python API numbers channels 1-12)

CDR_ENABLE.description: Bytes 74-75 (Tables 22/45). Low nibble of byte 74 (0x4A) = channels 8-11 (0-based); byte 75 (0x4B) = channels 0-7. High nibble of byte 74 is reserved and must be preserved on write.

CDR_LOL_STATUS.description: Bytes 20-21 (Tables 17/39), same channel/nibble layout as CDR_ENABLE. 1 = loss of lock for that channel.

CDR_LOL_MASK.description: Bytes 108-109 (Tables 27/50), same channel/nibble layout as CDR_ENABLE.

TEMP_ALARM_MASK.description: Default 0b0 (unmasked); Tables 25/26. Preserve unrelated bits on write.

VCC_ALARM_MASK.description: Default 0b0 (unmasked); Tables 25/26. Preserve unrelated bits on write.

STATUS_SUMMARY.description: Table 34. Bit 0 is cleared by reading this byte.

RX_LOS_LATCH.description: Latched RX Loss of Signal (12 channels). Latched bits clear on read or module reset.

RX_DISABLE.description: Per-channel RX disable (bits 0-11, 0-based). Table 40. NOT the same as RX_OUTPUT_DISABLE.

RX_OUTPUT_DISABLE.description: Per-channel electrical RX output disable. Table 41. A successful write here does not by itself prove the receiver channel (RX_DISABLE) was disabled.

RX_OUTPUT_AMP.description: Per-channel RX output amplitude, Table 43: 6 bytes packing two channel nibbles per byte (12 channels total, not 12 bytes).

RX_DEEMPHASIS.description: Per-channel RX de-emphasis, 6 bytes packing two channel nibbles per byte.

CDR_ENABLE.description: Bytes 74-75 (Tables 22/45). Low nibble of byte 74 (0x4A) = channels 8-11 (0-based); byte 75 (0x4B) = channels 0-7. High nibble of byte 74 is reserved and must be preserved on write.

CDR_LOL_STATUS.description: Bytes 20-21 (Tables 17/39), same channel/nibble layout as CDR_ENABLE. 1 = loss of lock for that channel.

CDR_LOL_MASK.description: Bytes 108-109 (Tables 27/50), same channel/nibble layout as CDR_ENABLE.

TEMP_ALARM_MASK.description: Default 0b0 (unmasked); Tables 25/26. Preserve unrelated bits on write.

VCC_ALARM_MASK.description: Default 0b0 (unmasked); Tables 25/26. Preserve unrelated bits on write.

MAX_TEMP.description: Max recommended case temp (°C, signed, default 0x46=70°C)

VENDOR_NAME.description: Reserved on this Rev. 4 map (Tables 28/51). NOT a valid vendor-name field for the standard x12 variant -- valid only on CERN-B (see firefly_cernb.json).

0x01.description: Alarm thresholds (factory preset) and RX optical power monitoring

RX_OPTICAL_POWER.description: Table 52. 12 channels x 2 bytes, unsigned big-endian, 0.1 µW/count. Channel order is DESCENDING: bytes 206-207 (0xCE-CF) = Rx11 .. bytes 228-229 (0xE4-E5) = Rx00. Not dBm; convert separately if needed.

TEMP_BIN_BASE.description: 22 temperature bins x 3 bytes (24-bit counters, 5-min LSB), bytes 128-193 (Tables 31/54)

PEAK_TEMP.description: Peak recorded case temperature (°C, unsigned), byte 194 immediately following the bin array

channel_monitoring.tx_power: Per-channel laser bias current and output power monitoring (implementation-dependent)
channel_monitoring.rx_power: See upper_pages.0x01.RX_OPTICAL_POWER for the actual field map, units and descending channel order
channel_monitoring.los: Loss of signal detection per channel

notes: Memory map based on InfiniBand CXP Interface Specification Volume 2
All multi-byte values are Big Endian
Upper pages selected via PAGE_SELECT byte at 0x7F
Int_L pin asserts on unmasked faults/alarms

Latched fault/alarm/status bits clear on read or module reset, and may re-assert immediately if the underlying condition persists and its mask bit is unset -- a plain RO access note does not capture this.

Tx and Rx are separate physical TWI devices (separate uart_address / device_number each). This file documents both directions' registers together because they share one datasheet; do not assume a single device exposes both tx_registers and rx_registers.
